anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet the battery-feed isolation Schottky U8 (SS2040FL) is drawn with its anode (pin 1, triangle side) tied to NET0053 (the BAT+ input rail, shared with IC2 VIN/EN, J6 VBUS and J2 pin 1) and its cathode (pin 2, bar side) tied to NET0037 (the barrel-jack switch return, J2 pin 3). The in-sheet note states '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug', so with no DC plug NET0037 = J2 pin 2 = GND. The diode is therefore oriented anode-on-BAT+ / cathode-on-GND, i.e. reverse of the intended battery-isolation diode.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification the battery diode must point anode→cathode→BAT+ ('U6 (SS2040FL) anode→cathode → BAT+', 'anode on battery (via U7), cathode on BAT+'), so the cathode sits on BAT+ and the anode on the battery side; the diode then blocks USB/adapter current from back-feeding into the cell.

evidence.quote: Battery (U7, 18650 holder) → pin 1 → Net-(U6-A) → U6 (SS2040FL) anode→cathode → BAT+. The battery is the only source routed through a series diode; USB (J3.1, VBUS) and the DC barrel jack (J4.1, center pin) tie directly onto BAT+ with no diode.

EthernetAndPower sheet: U8 SS2040FL with pin1 on NET0053 and pin2 on NET0037; J2 Barrel Jack Switch text note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug / 1 is center, center is positive'; J2.2→GND, J2.3→NET0037.

anomalies.impact: Because U8's anode is on BAT+ and its cathode is on NET0037 (which the jack's internal switch shorts to GND whenever no DC plug is inserted), any USB/adapter power on BAT+ forward-biases U8 and creates a near-direct short from BAT+ to GND through the diode and the jack switch. The intended battery-isolation function is inverted: the cell cannot feed BAT+ through the diode, and the board would latch up / overcurrent the USB or 5 V source as soon as it is connected without a DC plug.

parsed.summary: The component values and part identities match the specification, but the battery-feed isolation Schottky U8 is drawn with reversed polarity (anode on the BAT+ rail, cathode on the barrel-jack switch return that is shorted to GND with no plug), contradicting the spec's 'anode→cathode→BAT+' requirement and creating a BAT+-to-GND short path through U8 and J2.
